question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Lasting for a very short time
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2. i.e. Ephemeral.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ephemeral** (क्षणिक) - Lasting for a very short time.

 
 
• **Example**: The beauty of an ephemeral flower is captivating, yet fleeting.
 
 
 
• Ephemeral accurately expresses the given group of words "Lasting for a very short time" (बहुत कम समय तक चलने वाला)

Therefore, the correct answer is Ephemeral.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eternal **(अनन्त) - Lasting or existing forever; without end.
 
• **Blasphemy **(ईशनिंदा) - The act or offense of speaking sacrilegiously about God or sacred things.
 
• **Chronology** (कालक्रम) - The arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence.
